subject: prd/implement-now
statement: When an impl-review-owned host persistence adapter emits `prd:impl-review/EVT-13` for a completed-report publication attempt initiated from an implement-now review obligation, the executor shall append exactly one EVT-17 for the same publication moment. The terminal statuses and, when failed, failure classes shall agree, and the terminals shall carry these field-identical pairs with the same grammar and value: `review_process_id = review_attempt_id`, `review_obligation_id = review_obligation_id`, `proposal_id = proposal_ref`, `reviewed_revision = revision`, `artifact_ref = artifact_ref`, `native_receipt = native_receipt`, and `attempt_proof_ref = attempt_proof_ref`. The first four pairs shall be present on every paired terminal; the last three shall have identical presence, and all three shall be present when status is `verified`. `publication_attempt_id` shall remain impl-review's distinct child identity with no implement-now alias. EVT-15 shall remain the broader review-lifecycle terminal: its `artifact_proof_ref`, when present, shall equal EVT-17 `attempt_proof_ref`, shall never carry a native receipt, and shall not substitute for EVT-17 in cross-contract evidence. A missing, duplicate, orphaned, status/failure-class disagreement, field mismatch, or receipt/proof-overloaded pair shall remain non-evidentiary, preserve the review obligation as pending, and take FR-42's infrastructure class for absent/append failure or artifact-untrusted class for conflicting/substituted evidence.
rationale: exact field identity is the only reliable proof that impl-review's artifact publication and implement-now's review outcome describe one real reviewer attempt rather than two similar records
fit_criterion: verified and each failed-class fixture produce exactly one EVT-13↔EVT-17 pair with the same status, the same failure class when failed, the four required identities, and equal optional-field presence/value; every cross-class mismatch while status and all seven pairs match, plus missing, duplicate, orphaned, status/grammar/value mismatch, optional-presence mismatch, receipt/proof overload, and EVT-15-only fixtures never count toward M7 or clear pending and emit the required FR-42 class; verified pairs carry separate native receipt and attempt proof; `publication_attempt_id` never appears as an obligation or attempt alias
